entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the order number, please?

Thank you, Sarah. I see your account right here. Looks like you're one of our VIP members, we appreciate your business. Now, regarding the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just not for me. Frankly, I barely had time to look at it. There was a family emergency.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright.
My husband needed emergency surgery, so we've been at the hospital all week. I was worried I'd miss the return window.

I completely understand, and please don't worry about that. We always make exceptions for situations like that or for a military deployment. Let me just pull up the official policy for your item... one moment.

Okay, I've got it here. According to our policy, the VeloBand Cadence Sensor is eligible for a full refund within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it just six days ago, you are well within that timeframe. No exception needed.
Oh. So I worried for nothing. Whatever.

Not at all, it's always best to check. I have processed the return for you. You'll get an email with a pre-paid shipping label shortly. And for the trouble, and as a thank you for being a VIP, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase.
You're very welcome, Sarah. I truly hope things improve with your husband's recovery. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better day.
